_note: Legacy compatibility data (check_limits(limits=load_limits())). Shared typed profiles live in profiles.py. Each numeric value has a source id in the platform's _provenance; the source list is in _sources (V1-6, checked 2026-10-26). width/height for vertical platforms are the Lahza 1080x1920 preset, not a platform requirement. Values under 'api' apply to Instagram Graph API publishing only, not to manual uploads in the app.

ig_help_reels_length.note: Official Instagram Help Center article (facebook.com/help/instagram mirror of help.instagram.com/2720958398006062, which returned only a login/JS shell). Reels can be recorded as one or more clips totalling up to 20 minutes; reels longer than 3 minutes are not recommended to new audiences.

ig_creators_faq.note: 'We recommend videos to unconnected audiences that are 3 minutes or less.' 'Upload the highest resolution possible.'

ig_graph_api_reels.note: Reel specifications (API publishing): MOV/MP4, moov atom front, no edit lists; HEVC or H.264 progressive, closed GOP, 4:2:0; 23-60 FPS; max 1920 horizontal px; aspect 0.01:1-10:1, 9:16 recommended; VBR 25 Mbps max; AAC 48 kHz max, mono/stereo, 128 kbps; 3 s min, 15 min max; 300 MB max.

meta_reels_ads.note: Ads guide (paid placements only): 0 s - 15 min, up to 4 GB, 1440x2560 9:16, MP4/MOV, H.264, AAC >= 128 kbps, fixed frame rate.

ig_help_upload_specs.note: Returned a Help Center shell without article text; nothing taken from it.

yt_shorts_length.note: Videos with a square or vertical aspect ratio up to three minutes are categorized as Shorts (uploads after 2024-10-15).

yt_upload_size.note: Maximum upload 256 GB or 12 hours, whichever is less; by default 15 minutes unless the account is verified.

yt_encoding.note: Recommended (not required): MP4, H.264, same frame rate as recorded; AAC-LC/Opus 48 kHz, stereo 384 kbps; SDR 1080p 8 Mbps (24-30 fps) / 12 Mbps (48-60 fps); 16:9 standard on desktop.
